parsed.rationale: Three separate packages — DebugPanel and Wallpaper (twice, once in a sample-app file and once in production throttling code) — each declare an unnamed extension on ProcessInfo.ThermalState at lines 212, 236, and 230 respectively. Because the DebugPanel package already has a dedicated extension in DebugMetricsProvider.swift and is the most semantically appropriate home for thermal-state utilities, the two Wallpaper-side extensions should be removed and their consumers should import DebugPanel (or a shared utility target) instead. If a DebugPanel dependency is architecturally undesirable for the Wallpaper package, a thin shared utility package should be introduced to host the single canonical extension.
